Synthetic MECP header derived from the existing mecp_no_avb fixture. Its modem reservation/read size is updated to header+qcom_mbn_qcdt length; only that MBN input is appended. Expected hashes originate from the inputs, not the MECP parser. This checks MECP -> MBN -> QCDT recursion and exclusion of sibling-partition regions. No real modem firmware bytes or authentic signatures are used.
